title: DOUG ANTHONY ALLSTARS
tickerText: FROM BUSKING ON CANBERRA STREETS TO THE EDINBURGH FRINGE AND AUSTRALIAN TV CLASSICS THE BIG GIG AND DAAS KAPITAL, THE DOUG ANTHONY ALL STARS SPENT A DECADE MAKING COMEDY THAT WAS FEARLESS, ABRASIVE, ANARCHIC AND COMPLETELY UNPREDICTABLE. PAUL MCDERMOTT, RICHARD FIDLER AND TIM FERGUSON BUILT A REPUTATION WHERE NOTHING WAS SACRED AND NOBODY WAS SAFE. THEN, IN 1994, FERGUSON ABRUPTLY ENDED THE GROUP, LATER REVEALING HE WAS LIVING WITH MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS. YEARS LATER THEY REUNITED, WITH PAUL LIVINGSTON JOINING MCDERMOTT AND FERGUSON ON STAGE. THE DOCUMENTARY TICK F***ING TOCK REVISITED THE CHAOS, FRIENDSHIP, BREAK-UP AND EXTRAORDINARY HISTORY OF ONE OF AUSTRALIA’S MOST ORIGINAL COMEDY ACTS
